# Tenure IQ

> Property intelligence platform for UK landlords and investors managing HMO and buy-to-let portfolios. Track compliance, rent collection, financials, and portfolio performance from one dashboard.

Tenure IQ helps UK landlords and portfolio investors replace spreadsheets with a single source of truth — covering EICR / Gas Safety / EPC / HMO licence compliance, multi-entity (SPV) ownership, rent reconciliation, and lender-grade reporting.
